messages:
emma: Quick sync for the upcoming Microlaunch social push. Goals: drive webinar signups, capture demo leads, and test localized creative in EU/APAC. Need final assets, copy localization, and the pinned reply decided.

carlos: Uploaded master assets to Drive (15s, 30s, 9:16). Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-kit-ml. Will output burned captions for 9:16 shortly.

emma: can you also make a short trailer (6s) for X Reels? We want a very fast hook.

carlos: yep, 6s teaser coming in 2 hrs.

priya: Copy variants done. Three tones: product-led, metric-led, and developer-friendly. I'll add localized translations for FR/DE/JP.

emma: good. for A/B we'll run metric-led vs dev-friendly on X NA and EU only. APAC will use product-led with story clips.

tom: routing plan: /microlaunch?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=microlaunch_q2&utm_region={REGION}&utm_content={VARIANT}. Demo booking adds &intent=demo. Webhook posts leads to /api/leads with payload (handle, utm_campaign, region).

emma: want pinned reply to be demo clip + single stat card (median latency + percent cost reduction) and a short "Book a 15m demo" CTA. Reserve gated PDF for paid boost audiences only.

priya: gating note: one-pager benchmark behind email capture. I'll make the headline: "95ms median latency; 3x cost reduction vs baseline" so copy aligns.

emma: social cadence proposal: 
- NA: Tue 10:00 PT primary post (A/B on X)
- EU: Tue 11:00 CET amplifier repost with localized copy
- APAC: Wed 09:00 SGT boosted story/9:16 with CTA to gated PDF
Schedule reminders in calendar and queue drafts to #marketing-assets by Mon 18:00 PT.

tom: scheduled calendar events and created three campaign tags (region=NA/EU/APAC). Also created separate campaign variants for X A/B slots.

priya: engagement SOP: SDRs respond to comments/DMs within 90 minutes on weekdays. Two canned replies added: 
1) "Thanks! Here's the short demo: <clip>. Book a 15-min walkthrough: <book link>."
2) "Want the benchmark PDF? Leave your email here: <gated link>."

emma: can we add a pinned FAQ comment on LinkedIn for pricing/enterprise asks? Priya, can you draft FAQs and escalation guidance to sales?

priya: will draft. escalation: forward enterprise signals to sales@redwood.com with lead score tag "social-enterprise".

carlos: for the stat overlay, using brand bold white text on navy gradient (#0b2057). Exporting PNG at 1200x675 for X and 1080x1080 for LI.

emma: perfect. one more measurement note: track CTR, demo booking rate, and gated PDF downloads per variant/region. Tom please create tracking keys in the analytics sheet.

tom: created sheet and dashboard ticket. will populate after first 24h.

social-bot: Reminder queued: Drafts due in #marketing-assets Mon 18:00 PT. Post windows scheduled per region.

emma: blockers?

carlos: captions in progress, no blockers.

priya: translations needing 1 hr QA.

tom: webhook tested in staging.

emma: great work. i'll review tone Mon AM and approve. We'll run the X A/B for 48 hours then pick the winner for the EU repost. :rocket:
